scenarios.title: Create a Product with Valid Information
scenarios.business_objective: Allow signed-in users to add new products with valid details including edge boundary cases.
preconditions: User is authenticated and signed in.
User is on the product management form page.
steps: Enter a valid Product Name of exactly 50 characters.
Select a valid Category from the dropdown ('Books').
Enter a non-negative Price with 2 decimal places (e.g., '29.99').
Optionally enter a valid Description within 500 characters.
Click the Save button.
scenarios.expected_result: The Save button becomes disabled while saving, and the product is successfully created and added to the catalog.

scenarios.title: Validation Failure for Blank or Oversized Product Name
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure product names are required and strictly enforced to 1–50 characters.
preconditions: User is signed in.
User is attempting to save a product form.
steps: Attempt to save a product with a blank or empty Product Name.
Observe the validation error message displayed.
Enter a Product Name containing 51 characters.
Attempt to save the product form again.
Observe the validation error message displayed.
scenarios.expected_result: An empty name triggers 'Name is required'. A 51-character name triggers 'Name must be at most 50 characters'. Form submission is halted.

scenarios.title: Validation Failure for Negative Product Price
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure product price cannot be negative and is validated on both UI and server.
preconditions: User is signed in.
User is on the product creation form.
steps: Fill out a valid Product Name and select Category.
Enter a negative numerical value in the Price field (e.g., '-10.50').
Click the Save button.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation fails on both browser and server with the error 'Price must be zero or more', preventing product creation.

scenarios.title: Validation Failure for Invalid Category or Excessively Long Description
scenarios.business_objective: Enforce valid category choices (Books, Electronics, Home) and maximum 500-character description limit.
preconditions: User is signed in.
User is filling out the product form.
steps: Fill in valid Name and Price, but leave Category unselected, then click Save.
Verify the error message 'Please choose a category'.
Select 'Electronics' for Category.
Enter a Description string exceeding 500 characters.
Click the Save button.
scenarios.expected_result: The system rejects submission when Category is missing and displays 'Description must be at most 500 characters' when Description exceeds 500 characters.

scenarios.title: Plain Text Rendering and Script Escaping in Product Description
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure product descriptions display as plain text and block XSS execution.
preconditions: A product has been created with a description containing HTML and script tags (e.g., '<script>alert("xss")</script>').
steps: Navigate to the product detail page of the specified product.
Inspect the product description area.
scenarios.expected_result: The HTML and script tags are displayed literally as plain unformatted text and no script is executed.

scenarios.title: Duplicate Product Submission Prevention
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent unintended duplicate product records caused by rapid clicking or double form submissions within 5 seconds.
preconditions: User is signed in.
User has filled out valid product details on the form.
steps: Click the Save button.
Rapidly double-click or submit the same product name and price again within 5 seconds.
scenarios.expected_result: The Save button disables during saving, and the system creates exactly one product record.

scenarios.title: Permanent Product Deletion
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure deleted products are permanently purged from listing, search results, and direct page access.
preconditions: User is signed in.
An active product exists in the system.
steps: Initiate deletion of the product.
Observe the confirmation message.
Search for the deleted product in the catalog search and list views.
Attempt to open the direct detail URL of the deleted product and reload the page.
scenarios.expected_result: The page displays 'Product deleted', the item disappears from lists and search, and visiting its detail page returns 'Product not found'.

scenarios.title: API Product Creation Validation and Authorization via REST Endpoint
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure REST API mirror endpoint POST /api/products enforces identical validation and authentication controls as UI forms.
preconditions: API client is available.
steps: Send an unauthenticated POST request to '/api/products'.
Authenticate and send a POST request to '/api/products' with an invalid payload (e.g., negative price).
Send an authenticated POST request to '/api/products' with valid JSON JSON {name, price, category, description}.
scenarios.expected_result: Unauthenticated requests return 401 Unauthorized. Invalid payloads return HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with error details. Valid payloads return successful creation response.

scenarios.title: Add product to cart or update cart quantity with valid integer quantity
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure customers can select and update product quantities using valid whole numbers between 1 and 99.
preconditions: Customer is logged in and browsing a product page or viewing their cart.
steps: Navigate to a product details page.
Enter a valid quantity (e.g., 5) into the quantity input field and click 'Add to Cart'.
Navigate to the Cart page.
Update the product quantity to another valid integer between 1 and 99 (e.g., 10) and save changes.
scenarios.expected_result: The product quantity is set successfully in the cart without error messages.

scenarios.title: Reject invalid product quantity inputs on product page or cart
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent invalid cart quantities (non-integers, less than 1, or greater than 99) from being accepted.
preconditions: Customer is on a product page or managing items in their cart.
steps: Attempt to set item quantity to an invalid value such as 0, negative number (-1), value 100 or greater, or non-numeric text.
Submit the form to add item to cart or update quantity.
scenarios.expected_result: The input is rejected, and the error message 'Quantity must be between 1 and 99' is displayed.

scenarios.title: Calculate line totals, subtotal, discount, and total with half-up rounding to two decimal places
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure accurate monetary calculations rounded half up to 2 decimal places across all cart items and discounts.
preconditions: Customer is adding products with fractional pricing to the cart.
steps: Add 1 x Gel Pen priced at 1.005 to the cart.
Observe line total and total amount calculation.
Update Gel Pen quantity to 3.
Add 1 x Atlas of Maps priced at 19.95 to the cart and apply discount code SAVE10.
scenarios.expected_result: 1 x Gel Pen at 1.005 gives a total of 1.01. 3 x Gel Pen gives 3.02. 1 x Atlas of Maps (19.95) with SAVE10 gives a total of 17.96 (17.955 rounded half up to 2 decimal places).

scenarios.title: Apply valid discount code SAVE10 and handle duplicate or invalid discount code submissions
scenarios.business_objective: Allow customers to apply discount SAVE10 once per cart while rejecting invalid codes and duplicate applications.
preconditions: Customer has a non-empty cart.
steps: Enter an unknown discount code (e.g., 'INVALID10') and submit.
Verify system response.
Enter valid discount code 'SAVE10' and submit.
Verify 10% discount is applied to cart subtotal.
Attempt to re-apply 'SAVE10' to the same cart.
scenarios.expected_result: Unknown codes display 'Invalid discount code'. 'SAVE10' applies 10% off the cart. Re-applying displays 'Discount already applied' and the cart total remains unchanged.

scenarios.title: Prevent order checkout when cart is empty
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure empty carts cannot result in order creation.
preconditions: Customer's shopping cart contains 0 items.
steps: Navigate to checkout with an empty cart.
Attempt to place the order.
scenarios.expected_result: Order creation is prevented, no order record is saved, and the checkout page displays 'Your cart is empty'.

scenarios.title: Successfully place an order from a non-empty cart
scenarios.business_objective: Complete order placement, navigate to order confirmation with accurate order details, and clear the cart.
preconditions: Customer has items in their shopping cart.
steps: Initiate checkout from the non-empty cart.
Confirm and place the order.
scenarios.expected_result: The system creates the order, opens the order confirmation page showing 'Order #<id>', 'Thank you! Your order #<id> has been placed.', line items, and total, and empties the user's cart.

scenarios.title: Enforce authorization rules for viewing customer orders
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure customers can only view their own orders while administrators can view all orders.
preconditions: Order #101 belongs to Customer A. Order #102 belongs to Customer B.
steps: Log in as Customer A and navigate to order page `/orders/101` or send `GET /api/orders/101`.
Log in as Customer A and attempt to access Customer B's order page `/orders/102` or send `GET /api/orders/102`.
Log in as Administrator and access Customer B's order page `/orders/102`.
scenarios.expected_result: Customer A views Order #101 successfully. Attempting to view Order #102 returns HTTP 403 with 'Access denied'. Administrator accesses Order #102 successfully.
